name: chat-mastra
title: Chat: Mastra binding
description: A Mastra agent through the chat transport: a streamTurn for lib/chat-server-config.ts that runs a turn with agent.stream, renders it through @mastra/ai-sdk as the AI SDK's chunks, and settles the whole run's usage — every step of a tool loop, and the finished steps of a stopped or failed turn. Optional Mastra memory scoped to the conversation, the workspace and the user. Consumer-owned. Requires the chat item.
